meta.name: refactoring
meta.description: Refactoring process. Invoke immediately when user or document mentions refactoring, or proactively when code gets too complex or messy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构混乱代码，提升代码质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得复杂难以维护
copy.tagline_en: Refactor messy code to improve quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code has become complex and hard to maintain

howto.what: 当用户要求或代码复杂时，Claude会自动进行代码重构：清理注释、重命名变量、提取方法、删除无用代码等，并确保测试通过。最终输出优化后的代码和重构摘要。
howto.when: 当用户提到“重构”或代码变得复杂/混乱时，Claude会主动启动重构流程。

say.text: 请重构这个文件，先做最简单的改进。
say.note: Claude会从简单到复杂逐步重构。

say.text: 检查当前项目代码，哪里需要重构？
重构所有相关文件，但要逐个提交。
say.note: 每次重构后都会测试并提交。

howto.what_en: When user requests or code gets complex, Claude automatically refactors code: removes comments, renames variables, extracts methods, deletes dead code, etc., ensuring tests pass. Outputs optimized code and summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user mentions 'refactoring' or code becomes complex/messy.

say_en.text: Refactor this file, start with the simplest improvement.
say_en.note: Claude proceeds from simple to complex.

say_en.text: Check the current project code, where needs refactoring?
Refactor all related files but commit one by one.
say_en.note: Each refactor is tested and committed.
